environment.description: Node.js 16 Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance with database user 'app_service' granted full privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables. No request validation middleware. ELB forwards raw TCP without header inspection.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB in TCP passthrough mode
config.db_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
config.network: Public subnet, port 4000 exposed via ELB
